name: refuter
description: Refuter orchestrator + 6 subagents (scout, researcher, builder, refuter, auditor, memory) and their MCP servers. Subagents work through the job-file protocol in .claude/refuter/job/; the orchestrator is the only agent that talks to you. Run /baton:setup to enable the Task tools (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS) in the project's .claude/settings.json.
